newsitem.title: UK: B&N and Viking to build three ice breakers.
newsitem.headline: B&N and Viking to build three ice breakers.

text.p: Norwegian support vessel operator Viking Supply Ships AS has formed a joint venture with Swedish shipping group Bylock & Nordsjofrakt to build three new large anchor handling icebreakers.
Terms have not been disclosed, although press reports from Sweden estimated the value of the new ships would be around Swedish crowns 1 billion.
A spokesman for Viking Supply Ships said the joint venture had not yet placed a shipyard order. Enquiries will be started shortly.
The vessels will be chartered for 15 years to the Swedish ports authority over the winter months to act as ice-breakers.
The spokesman said other employment would be sought for the remaining months of the year.
"The ships will be large anchor handling support vessels of around 15,000 brake horse power."
Viking Supply Ships operates a fleet of around 25 support vessels.
Bylock & Nordsjofrakt is a diversified shipping group with interests in container and forest products shipping.
